title: DeepSeek Harness
note: The forks are built from this tag's source through the unmodified official packages/client/tsdown.client.ts preset. Only the preset's node half is dropped (it needs a workspace-wide tsc project graph that the fork does not change); with DSH_BUILD_FACE unset the client entry is src/client/index.ts, so the browser artifact builds straight from TSX. Acquiring the tag: `git fetch` of this tag hangs in this environment (smart-HTTP), so use codeload with a resumable download: curl.exe -sS -L -C - --max-time 120 -o <file> <tarball>.
fidelity: Building an UNMODIFIED 0.2.0-rc.2 ui-layout through this root reproduces the published npm artifact exactly after normalizing seed-derived CSS class hashes, build-path region comments, @__PURE__ annotations and require ordering (scripts/compare-client-bundles.mjs prints EQUIVALENT). ui-workspace and ui-user-questions differ from their npm artifacts only by inlined TS downleveling helpers (__create/__defProp et al.) that the CI route had already lowered via the tsc intermediate; the programs are semantically equivalent.
